name: Oud Mirage
headline: YOUR OWN POINT OF VIEW.
personality: For someone independent and reflective, who trusts their own taste and feels comfortable taking a different path.
primaryText:
For someone independent and reflective, who trusts their own taste and feels comfortable taking a different path.

Explore Oud Mirage and discover which fragrance feels like you. Tap Find Your Scent to explore your match.

#DearBodyPH #AScentJourney
description: Discover your match with Dear Body.
concept: A reflective personal pause at a sunny orange window ledge: one adult Filipino man's hands and lap only, wearing cream trousers and a burgundy textured knit cuff. One hand holds complete OUD MIRAGE blue-liquid perfume with black label in front of a CLOSED burgundy notebook and one brass pen resting horizontally. The other hand touches the notebook's elastic. Small folded cobalt canvas edge tucked low at right, no bags inhand, no sporting gear, no phones or screens, no book illustration/text, no head/chin/reflections. Warm burnt-orange painted wooden ledge dominates with strong geometric window-frame shadows but no actual glass in view. Quiet individual style, inviting sunlight rather than brooding. Top30% empty warmorange wall. Bottle x55%,y57%, intact fullcapandbase, naturallysmall50ml, blue as limited accent.
